description: This is a test class for the MenuService in a Human Resource Management system, containing unit tests for menu item generation based on user roles and context.

classes.name: MenuServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the MenuService, testing menu item retrieval for different user roles and contexts.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures from YAML files before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MenuService instance and disables I18N in the config.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Re-enables I18N in the config after each test.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForAdmin
methods.description: Tests menu items returned for an admin user based on request URL and user context.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForSupervisor
methods.description: Tests menu items returned for a supervisor user based on request URL and user context.
